svg.title: Red Curve II
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. White upper cap inside the wide diamond retained. Actual museum-published MoMA1973 plate is used, with physical dimensions from its caption. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
